'''Indrahar''' was a kingdom of the [[Third Age#Free Years|Free Years]]. It was founded after the end of the [[Trolloc Wars]], and was established on the former territories of [[Jaramide]] and northern [[Aridhol]]. It was later absorbed by the growing might of [[Artur Hawkwing's Empire]]. The lands it once held are now partially controlled by [[Arad Doman]], but are mostly wilderness.

==Geography==
[[Image:Indrahar.png|thumb|right|200px|In red location within the Westlands]]

Indrahar was located at the northern end of the [[Mountains of Mist]]. It controlled territory on both sides of the mountains and also around their northern edge. Its borders almost reached [[World's End]] in the northwest, but mainly formed a square shape centered on the northern peaks of the mountains. Its neighbors were [[Abayan]] to the west, [[Oman Dashar]] to the south, [[Oburun]] to the east, and [[Basharande]] to the north.

==History==
Very little is known of Indrahar beyond the name, save that it was later conquered by [[Artur Paendrag Tanreall|Artur Hawkwing]] and made part of his empire. During the subsequent [[War of the Hundred Years]] Indrahar's territory was partially absorbed by Arad Doman.
